Every time you step into the shop, you’re greeted with a smile and treated like family. The variety here is amazing – from daily stationery needs to creative art supplies, everything is handpicked with so much care. ✨ What makes this place stand out is the personal touch and the owners’ genuine interest in guiding and helping customers find exactly what they need.

In today’s world where shops are often just about transactions, Lakshmi Art & Stationery is truly different – it’s about relationships, trust, and spreading happiness along with products. 🌟

featured_reviews.name: Bhavna Randive
featured_reviews.review_text:
I found this place on the web while searching for the best resin art materials. I saw their shop reviews and visit the place next day. I must tell you it was worth visiting here. I love the variety of stuff you get there. Staff is very helpful and suggest you the best things.
One more best part of this shop is you get the stuff in lower price with the best quality. You will get everything you need to do resin art.. including their inhouse resin and Hardener. Which is very cheap as compared to other brands.
The shop is on the first floor of the building and there are many small shops in front of the building so it is quite difficult to find it as you can't se it's board... So you have to ask other shop keepers.
Overall it was a good experience. And they do home delivery. Gonna visit it again. Got best deals.
